simple.summary: כָּתַשׁ (kâthash) means to butt or pound First listed occurrence: Prov 27 22.

definitions.full: H3806. kathash [ כָּתַשׁ ] verb pound, pound fine, bray (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic כְּתַשׁ ; Syriac is strive, contend ; Zinjirli כתש break in pieces, shatter , DHM Sendsch. 58 ); — Qal Imperfect בַּמַּכְתֵּשׁ אֶתהָֿאֱוִיל אִםתִּֿכְתּוֺשׁ Prov 27:22 if thou shouldest bray the fool in the mortar.
